description: Change the PHP version a Cloud for WordPress site runs. `version` must be one of `wordpress.site.availablePhpVersions` from get_hosting. Takes effect within a minute or two; if the site misbehaves, switch back the same way. Confirm with the user first.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

name: set_wordpress_php_version
title: Set Wordpress Php Version
